issues.title: Bug: TREAT15 gives the wrong discount (1,633 AMD on an 8,550 AMD order, 1,283 for a new customer) instead of 1,282 AMD
issues.expected: TREAT15 is applied: a discount of 1,282 AMD (15% of 8,550, delivery free, 1,282.5 rounded down) and a new total of 7,268 AMD are shown
issues.observed: "TREAT15 applied: 15% off"; Subtotal 8,550 AMD, Delivery Free, "Discount (TREAT15)" −1,633 AMD, Total 6,917 AMD. Retry (reloaded checkout, applied again): same −1,633 AMD / 6,917 AMD. Step 08 (new customer): received "Discount (TREAT15)−1,283 AMDTotal7,267 AM"
steps: Open https://foodme-nairamnatsakanyan.onrender.com/chef/17 (Chef Verona: delivery fee 500 AMD, free delivery from a 5,000 AMD subtotal), signed in as a customer, with an empty cart and no promo code applied
Add 8 × Tart with cherry (1,000 AMD each) to the cart
Add 1 × Pie with beans (550 AMD) to the cart
Go to checkout and choose Delivery
Type TREAT15 in the promo code field and press Apply
issues.priority_reason: Money is wrong: the discount differs from the rule (1,633 AMD in 05, 1,283 AMD in 08) and the customer can't avoid it
